questions.explanation_ar: أم أمي هي جدتي: grandmother. sister معناها أخت وaunt معناها عمة أو خالة.
questions.explanation_en: My mother's mother is my grandmother: grandmother. sister means أخت and aunt means عمة or خالة.

questions.prompt: My father's other son is my ___.
questions.explanation_ar: ابن أبويا التاني هو أخويا: brother. sister بنت، وgrandfather جد.
questions.explanation_en: My father's other son is my brother: brother. sister is a girl, and grandfather is جد.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (جدي) معناها grandfather. grandmother جدة، وfather أب.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (جدي) means grandfather. grandmother is جدة, and father is أب.

questions.explanation_ar: السؤال Who's this؟ والرد بيعرّف: This is my sister. كلمة This لوحدها ناقصة، وThat للبعيد.
questions.explanation_en: The question Who's this? and the reply introduces: This is my sister. The word This alone is incomplete, and That is for something far.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (فوق) معناها on، فاللمبة on the table. under تحت وin جوه.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (فوق) means on, so the lamp is on the table. under is تحت and in is جوه.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (تحت) معناها under، فالقطة under the table.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (تحت) means under, so the cat is under the table.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (بجوار) معناها next to، يعني جنب الطبق.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (بجوار) means next to, meaning beside the plate.

questions.explanation_ar: بناكل في الطبق (plate). السرير والمصباح مش للأكل.
questions.explanation_en: We eat on the plate (plate). The bed and the lamp are not for eating.

questions.explanation_ar: بنشرب الشاي في الكوب (cup). الطبق للأكل، والسرير للنوم.
questions.explanation_en: We drink tea from the cup (cup). The plate is for eating, and the bed is for sleeping.

questions.explanation_ar: بننام في السرير (bed). الكرسي والترابيزة مش للنوم.
questions.explanation_en: We sleep in the bed (bed). The chair and the table are not for sleeping.

questions.explanation_ar: اللمبة (lamp) بتدّي نور بالليل. الكوب والباب مش بيدّوا نور.
questions.explanation_en: The lamp (lamp) gives light at night. The cup and the door do not give light.

questions.prompt: Where ___ the lamp? — On the table.
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال عن حاجة واحدة (the lamp)، فنستخدم is: Where is the lamp؟
questions.explanation_en: The question is about one thing (the lamp), so we use is: Where is the lamp?

questions.prompt: Where ___ the chairs? — In the dining room.
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال عن أكتر من كرسي (chairs)، فنستخدم are: Where are the chairs؟
questions.explanation_en: The question is about more than one chair (chairs), so we use are: Where are the chairs?

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة (أنثى) تدل إن الأم woman يعني سيدة. man رجل وboy ولد.
questions.explanation_en: The word (أنثى) shows that mom is a woman, meaning سيدة. man is رجل and boy is ولد.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (أخت) معناها sister. brother أخ وmother أم.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (أخت) means sister. brother is أخ and mother is أم.

questions.explanation_ar: This is my grandfather. my معناها بتاعي. I وme مش بنحطهم قبل الاسم.
questions.explanation_en: This is my grandfather. my means بتاعي. We do not put I and me before the noun.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (داخل) معناها in، فالكورة in the box. on فوق وunder تحت.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (داخل) means in, so the ball is in the box. on is فوق and under is تحت.

questions.prompt: I help my ___ clean the home.
questions.explanation_ar: بنساعد أمنا (mother) في تنضيف البيت. المكتب واللمبة مش أشخاص بنساعدهم.
questions.explanation_en: We help our mother (mother) clean the house. The desk and the lamp are not people we help.

questions.explanation_ar: بنحط الأكل على الطبق (plate). المصباح والشباك مش للأكل.
questions.explanation_en: We put food on the plate (plate). The lamp and the window are not for eating.

questions.prompt: My parents, my brother and I are a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: والداي وأخي وأنا عائلة: family. العلاقة الأسرية هنا واضحة من parents وbrother، مش من عدد الأشخاص أو شكلهم.
questions.explanation_en: My parents, my brother and I are a family: family. The family relationship here is clear from parents and brother, not from the number of people or how they look.

questions.prompt: My dad's dad is my grandfather; my mum's mum is my ___.
questions.explanation_ar: أم أمي هي جدتي: grandmother. الجملة بتقارن بين الجد والجدة.
questions.explanation_en: My mother's mother is my grandmother: grandmother. The sentence compares the grandfather and the grandmother.

questions.prompt: We have the same parents. She is my ___.
questions.explanation_ar: لما يكون لنا نفس الوالدين، البنت تكون أختي: sister. مش مجرد بنت بنلعب معاها.
questions.explanation_en: When we have the same parents, the girl is my sister: sister. Not just a girl we play with.

questions.prompt: We have the same parents. He is my ___.
questions.explanation_ar: لما يكون لنا نفس الوالدين، الولد يكون أخي: brother. حب كرة القدم وحده مش دليل على القرابة.
questions.explanation_en: When we have the same parents, the boy is my brother: brother. Loving football alone is not a clue to being related.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (أم) معناها mother، وهي اللي بتطبخ أكل حلو.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (أم) means mother, and she is the one who cooks tasty food.

questions.prompt: My ___ goes to work every day. (أب)
questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (أب) معناها father، وهو اللي بيروح الشغل كل يوم.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (أب) means father, and he is the one who goes to work every day.

questions.explanation_en: We turn on the lamp (lamp) when it is dark. A lamp gives light.
